lines.text: Jacob gathers his sons and tells Reuben, his firstborn, he will no longer excel because he defiled his father's bed.
Jacob says Simeon and Levi kill men in anger, and he will disperse them in Jacob.
Jacob calls Judah a young lion whose brothers will praise him, and says the scepter stays until Shiloh comes.
Zebulun will dwell by the seashore with his border reaching to Tyre, and Dan will be a snake.
Jacob tells his sons to bury him in the cave in Canaan where he buried Rachel, then he dies.
